## Welcome

I am a pharmacometrician, researcher, educator, and author. My work uses quantitative modeling and scientific computing to support drug development, and I enjoy making complex ideas clear through teaching, writing, and science communication.

This site brings together my research and publications, books, podcasts, media, and educational projects.
